name: app-6a8b5d210fc48191af634a5c54a77762
description: Search WallaShops electronics and home goods by category, compare prices, and find current deals.

interface.longDescription: WallaShops' electronics, home-goods and lifestyle catalogue on wallashops.co.il, in real time. Browse a category's brands and filters, search products and compare their prices and warranties, and ask about current promotions, delivery, returns and payment in plain language.
defaultPrompt: Find me a 1.7 litre electric kettle under ₪250.
What brands and screen sizes can I filter TVs by?
What are the current promotions, and how long does delivery take?

positive.prompt: Find me a front-loading washing machine with an 8 kg capacity.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows washing-machine cards filtered to front-loading, 8 kg, and points out two or three with their prices and why each fits.

positive.prompt: What brands and screen sizes can I filter TVs by?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the TV brands and screen sizes on offer, without presenting them as products.

positive.prompt: Do you have the iPhone 16 Pro 256GB?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches by the model name and shows matching listings with prices and product links, or says none were found.

positive.prompt: What is the return policy, and how long does delivery take?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from the knowledge base with its source links, without inventing terms.

positive.prompt: Are there any deals on air conditioners right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the knowledge base first. Shares a matching deal page with its link, or else shows air conditioners without claiming a discount.

negative.description: Order tracking, which the app cannot do
A flight, which the store does not sell
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Rome next week.
What will the weather be in Tel Aviv tomorrow?

he-IL.subtitle: מוצרים ומדיניות החנות
he-IL.description: הקטלוג של וואלה שופס, אלקטרוניקה, מוצרים לבית ולייף סטייל, בזמן אמת. עיינו במותגים ובמסננים של כל קטגוריה, חפשו מוצרים והשוו מחירים ואחריות, ושאלו על מבצעים, משלוחים, החזרות ואמצעי תשלום בשפה פשוטה.
